body:
Part of #7783 (D47 approved by the maintainer). Stacked on #7875 (C6-10); retargets to main once the C6 stack lands.

Class: X. The flat exports gain rows they never wrote. Single values are unchanged.

## What
- `EXPORT_PROPERTY_SCOPE` becomes `PropertyScope::Flat`: the one switch C6-7 prepared. CSV, JSON, JSON-LD, IFCX, USD, BOS and the Python `entity_data` now write enumerated, list, bounded, table, reference and complex properties. Each is written as the columnar display string with `kind = Text` and `value_type` = the members' shared tag, else the property class keyword (D47, `flat_property`).
- New `PropertyScope::Flat` variant (`#[non_exhaustive]` enum, so no break). It decodes the six other kinds exactly as `AllKinds` does. A single value is decoded as `SingleValueOnly` does, as its raw nominal value with no display form. `AllKinds` built that display form for every single value and the flat encoder never reads it. That cost +5.4% instructions on schependomlaan's CSV with no output change. `flat_tests` pins that `Flat` renders exactly what `AllKinds` renders.
- Complex properties stay under the model's one `ComplexPropertyBudget` (#7675). The decoder has no budget-less constructor, and the export builds one decoder per model.
- Docs: `docs/guide/exporting.md`, `docs/api/python.md`, `rust/python/README.md`, `.pyi` and the `entity_data` doc. Changeset: `@ifc-lite/export` minor.

## Evidence
- Goldens re-pinned. Only `c6_data_model_synthetic` moves, the C6-0 fixture that carries the six other kinds, and every moved case grows:
  - csv entities +236 B, properties +610 B; json +400 B; jsonld +554 B; parquet-bos +162 B; usd +506 B.
  - export-model attributes +580 B, inherit and inherit+attributes +1,740 B.
  - Python entity-data synthetic cases +472 to +1,416 B.
  - ifcx and the server route goldens are unmoved. `geometry-data-json.json` and the module-size digests are untouched.
- Single values are unchanged on the corpus. On CSV properties output, every old row is still present (base vs branch line multisets):
  - schependomlaan, ISSUE_068, AC20-FZK-Haus, duplex and S_Office gain 0 rows.
  - advanced_model gains 728 rows (Pset_*TypeCommon enumerations).
  - c6_data_model_synthetic gains 6 rows.
- Perf, cachegrind instructions at RAYON 1, base = C6-10 head:

  | Model | CSV properties | JSON | BOS |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | schependomlaan | +0.01% | +0.01% | +0.01% |
  | advanced_model (new rows) | +0.23% | +0.32% | +0.02% |

- Gate: clippy -D warnings, `cargo test --workspace`, `-p ifc-lite-export --features parquet-bos`, export and route goldens at RAYON 1 and 8, `rust/python` cargo test and pytest. The node guards and their `.test.mjs`, including check-changeset-bump, all pass.

## Not fixed
- JSON-LD labels every flat property row `ifc:IfcPropertySingleValue` (`jsonld.rs:87`). `PropValue` carries no property class, and adding one is a public-struct break, so the new kinds carry that label too.
- Budget charge order in the streaming export is product order (a set is re-decoded per product), not the server's set order. A cut, if one ever happens, can land on a different property than on the server. Whether any corpus model reaches the budget was not measured.
